_comment: Timeline of the standalone streaming overlay (`overlay.html?code=...`), read by `js/overlay.js` at boot. Every duration is in milliseconds; `booster.spinStepPerFrame` is the booster rotation applied on each animation frame (radians). The overlay publishes these values to `css/overlay.css` as CSS variables (--ov-*) so the script and the stylesheet never disagree, and it falls back to its built-in defaults for any missing or invalid key: deleting a line is always safe.
_sequence: intro (booster spinning) -> cardEntryMs + flipDelayMs + cardHoldMs per card -> summaryHoldMs on the grid -> fadeOutMs before the page goes blank.
_sound: Set `sound.enabled` to false to run the overlay silently (a stream usually has its own audio). `sound.volume` is in [0, 1]. The files live in `assets/sound/` and are shared with the game: `booster_opening.mp3` when the booster is torn open, `card_return.mp3` on every flip, then `card_rarity_4.mp3` / `card_rarity_5.mp3` when the revealed card has that rarity.
